name: cobol-procedure-division-model-limits
body: parse_procedure_division diagnoses and drops statements before the first paragraph, parses then drops a declarative USE sentence, records ALTER PROCEED TO targets as plain refs, and keeps no IF/EVALUATE branch structure. Limit: a program whose procedure division has no paragraph header yields no statements, and USE file references are lost. Upgrade when facts need pre-paragraph statements, USE targets or ALTER targets.
